journal.product.name: Journal
journal.root.title: Your own words, {break}echoed back.
journal.root.paragraph: Once you have an account and twenty written pages, passages you wrote before appear beside the page when they speak to the same thing. Nothing is interpreted and nothing is graded.
journal.root.searchText: Type a feeling and find the pages that mean it. The search runs in your browser, on your device.
journal.root.pageText: Yesterday sits a line above, and the cursor is already waiting.
journal.root.gradedText: No streaks, no scores and no share button.
journal.root.firstPage: The first ten minutes were the hardest. After that, the water made sense. I stopped trying to control everything and started paying attention.
journal.root.secondPage: Stayed out until the light changed. The walk home was longer than it needed to be. I think that was the point.
journal.root.todayFirst: Walked the long way home. No headphones this time.
journal.root.todaySecond: The city was louder than I remembered. So was my head.
journal.root.todayThird: By the river, both got quiet.
journal.root.echoPassage: “Took the path by the river. Ten minutes without my phone and I could hear myself think again.”
journal.talk.signOutDiscards: A recording waiting in Talk will be discarded.
journal.landingHead.title: Journal App With Search by Meaning | Windmill Journal
journal.landingHead.description: One continuous page a night. Search finds what you wrote by meaning, on your device. No streaks, no scores, no sharing.
